name: text_to_video
description: Generate a Wan VACE clip from text. Returns job_id; poll get_video_task with download=true until terminal.

name: image_to_video
description: Animate first_frame_url using Wan VACE. Returns job_id; poll get_video_task with download=true until terminal.

name: reference_to_video
description: Generate a Wan VACE clip guided by ref_image_urls for subject consistency. Returns job_id; poll get_video_task with download=true until terminal.

name: video_to_video
description: Edit video_url with Wan VACE. Choose freeform, inpainting, outpainting, reframe, depth, or pose. Inpainting needs one mask; outpainting needs expansion sides. Returns job_id; poll get_video_task with download=true until terminal.

edit_mode.description: Allowed values: freeform, inpainting, outpainting, reframe, depth, pose.

task.description: Allowed values: inpainting, outpainting, reframe, depth, pose.

name: vidu_q4_i2v
description: Animate image_url with Vidu Q4 native audio at 540p through 4K for 3 to 16 seconds. Prompt is optional. Returns job_id; poll get_video_task with download=true until terminal. Hosted service terms apply; outputs are not training eligible.

image_url.description: Public URL or base64 data URI of the first frame. PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 50 MB.

seed.description: Optional unrestricted integer seed. Omit it to use a random seed.

enable_safety_checker.description: Defaults to true. Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

name: vidu_q4_r2v
description: Generate Vidu Q4 video using an optional list of up to 12 reference images and 3 MP3 voice clips. Refer to images with [@reference_image_1] and voices with [reference_audio_1]. Audio defaults to false; set audio=true for dialogue and sound effects. Returns job_id; poll get_video_task with download=true until terminal. Outputs are not training eligible.

reference_image_urls.description: Optional list of up to 12 reference images. Public URLs or base64 data URIs of PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.

reference_audio_urls.description: Optional list of up to 3 MP3 reference voice clips. Each clip is 3 to 12 seconds and at most 50 MB. Use public URLs or base64 data URIs.

seed.description: Optional unrestricted integer seed. Omit it to use a random seed.

audio.description: Generate dialogue and sound effects when true. Defaults to false, which produces silent video.

enable_safety_checker.description: Defaults to true. Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

name: generate_wan3_t2v
description: Generate Wan 3 text-to-video, 2 to 30 seconds at 480p/720p/1080p, with native audio by default. Always request approval with a cost estimate, including autonomous runs. Poll get_video_task with download=true. Closed weights and commercial hosted API; outputs are not training eligible.

duration.description: Output seconds from 2 to 30, default 5. Null requests smart duration in dry-run only; live smart duration is blocked until billing reconciliation exists.

audio.description: Include native generated audio. Defaults to true.

seed.description: Optional integer from 0 to 2147483647. Omit for a random seed.

enable_safety_checker.description: Defaults to true. Disabling requires vendor account authorization.

real_face_refs.description: True when references contain a real person's likeness. Requires likeness_consent=true.

likeness_consent.description: Acknowledge permission to use every real person's referenced likeness. Local policy field; never sent to fal.

name: generate_wan3_i2v
description: Animate start_image_url with Wan 3, optionally constrained by end_image_url. Real-person likeness references require real_face_refs=true and likeness_consent=true. Always request approval with cost, then poll get_video_task with download=true.

start_image_url.description: Required first frame, as an HTTP(S) URL or base64 data URI.

end_image_url.description: Optional last frame, as an HTTP(S) URL or base64 data URI.

duration.description: Output seconds from 2 to 30, default 5. Null requests smart duration in dry-run only; live smart duration is blocked until billing reconciliation exists.

audio.description: Include native generated audio. Defaults to true.

seed.description: Optional integer from 0 to 2147483647. Omit for a random seed.

enable_safety_checker.description: Defaults to true. Disabling requires vendor account authorization.

real_face_refs.description: True when references contain a real person's likeness. Requires likeness_consent=true.

likeness_consent.description: Acknowledge permission to use every real person's referenced likeness. Local policy field; never sent to fal.

name: generate_wan3_r2v
description: Generate Wan 3 from up to 10 images, 5 videos totaling 15 seconds and 5 audio clips totaling 15 seconds. Supply measured reference_video_durations, reference_video_fps and reference_audio_durations alongside the matching URLs. Input video seconds also incur cost. Real-person likeness requires consent. Always request approval with cost, then poll get_video_task with download=true.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 10 reference image URLs or base64 data URIs.

reference_video_urls.description: Up to 5 video references totaling at most 15 seconds, each at least 16 fps. Input video seconds are billed in addition to output seconds.

reference_audio_urls.description: Up to 5 audio references totaling at most 15 seconds.

reference_video_durations.description: Locally measured seconds for each reference video, in the same order. Required when video references exist; never sent to fal.

reference_video_fps.description: Locally measured frame rate for each reference video, in the same order. Every reference must be at least 16 fps; never sent to fal.

reference_audio_durations.description: Locally measured seconds for each reference audio clip, in the same order. Required when audio references exist; never sent to fal.

file_url.description: Document URL or data URI. Requires enable_thinking=true.

web_url.description: Public HTTP(S) webpage that requires no login. Requires enable_thinking=true.

duration.description: Output seconds from 2 to 30, default 5. Null requests smart duration in dry-run only; live smart duration is blocked until billing reconciliation exists.

audio.description: Include native generated audio. Defaults to true.

seed.description: Optional integer from 0 to 2147483647. Omit for a random seed.

enable_safety_checker.description: Defaults to true. Disabling requires vendor account authorization.

real_face_refs.description: True when references contain a real person's likeness. Requires likeness_consent=true.

likeness_consent.description: Acknowledge permission to use every real person's referenced likeness. Local policy field; never sent to fal.

name: get_video_task
description: Poll an existing fal job_id once. Fetch completed results and optionally download the MP4. Never submits another generation.

name: list_fal_models
description: List documented Wan VACE, Wan 3.0 and Vidu Q4 models, endpoints, licences, and published pricing. Static catalog; no network or generation.
